item.title: Didgeridoo 0.5.0
item.description:
• First version: a synthesized didgeridoo with 25 parameters in three groups (Mouth, Lips, Rhythm) and six built-in programs.
  • Standalone app with a keyboard strip, a choice of MIDI input device and channel, a choice of audio output device and channel pair, and its own MIDI port "Didgeridoo" for other applications.
  • Audio Unit instrument for Ableton Live, Logic Pro and other hosts, installed from the app's Settings window. It uses the host's standard parameter view; it has no window of its own yet.
  • The app follows the audio hardware: it moves with the system default output, and when a chosen device is unplugged it plays on the default until the device is back.
  • Pitch drift wanders equally fast at every sample rate. This is the one deliberate difference from the MPC plugin "Didgeridoo", whose drift speeds up with the rate; at 44.1 kHz the two sound identical.
  • For Macs with Apple silicon, macOS 14 or later.
